title: D2 keycustodian error codes spec
description: Domain-specialized copy of contracts/error-codes/error-codes.canonical.schema.json, narrowed to the keycustodian catalog: the KEYCUSTODIAN_* code-prefix regex, the [400, 404, 409, 500] httpStatus subset, and the {validation_failure, not_found, conflict, internal_error} category subset. Conforms to the canonical 7-field set (including factoryShape) but tightens the value constraints so editors catch a non-KEYCUSTODIAN_ code, an out-of-subset status, or an out-of-subset category at edit time. The 400/validation_failure codes carry user-facing input-validation rejections; the 404/not_found + 409/conflict codes carry lifecycle-state failures (key not found, illegal transition, duplicate pending); the 500/internal_error codes carry programmer/precondition violations and failed smoke tests surfaced as flagged results instead of thrown exceptions. This is the source-of-truth catalog that D2.Edge.KeyCustodian.ErrorCodes.SourceGen reads to emit KeyCustodianErrorCodes.g.cs + KeyCustodianFailures.g.cs into D2.Edge.KeyCustodian.Domain. A drift-guard test asserts this copy stays field-aligned with the canonical schema.

code.description: Wire-format error code (SCREAMING_SNAKE, KEYCUSTODIAN_*-prefixed). Must be unique across the spec.

httpStatus.description: HTTP status mapping. Drives both transport-side response shape AND gRPC StatusCode mapping at the transport binding (400 -> InvalidArgument, 404 -> NotFound, 409 -> AlreadyExists/Aborted, 500 -> Internal). In the unified generator it selects the base D2Result delegation factory (400 -> ValidationFailed, 404 -> NotFound, 409 -> Conflict, 500 -> UnhandledException). 400 carries user-facing input-validation rejections; 404 carries key-not-found lookups; 409 carries illegal-transition / duplicate-pending conflicts; 500 carries programmer/precondition violations and failed smoke tests surfaced as flagged internal-error results instead of thrown exceptions. Expanding the matrix requires updating the codegen mapping (D2KEC005 fires on unknown values).

category.description: Closed semantic/telemetry classification. NOT the factory selector — httpStatus drives factory selection. Added to the wire (gRPC trailers + JSON envelope) so consumers can do generic class-based handling without importing the producer's catalog. validation_failure pairs with the 400 input-validation codes; not_found pairs with the 404 key-lookup codes; conflict pairs with the 409 illegal-transition / duplicate-pending codes; internal_error pairs with the 500 precondition-violation + smoke-test-failed codes (the 'it's our bug' alert class).

userMessageKey.description: Translation key reference rendered as the messages argument on the emitted D2Result factory (e.g. TK.Keycustodian.Validation.SOAK_NOT_ELAPSED). The generator enforces existence by inverse-transforming the symbol path to the snake_case key (TK.Keycustodian.Validation.SOAK_NOT_ELAPSED -> keycustodian_validation_SOAK_NOT_ELAPSED) and asserting membership in contracts/messages/en-US.json (D2ERC002). Coarse on purpose - one key per status bucket so the user-facing surface does not leak which validation step failed.

factoryName.description: PascalCase symbol for the emitted factory method (e.g. KidInvalid, SoakNotElapsed). Must be unique across the spec.

factoryShape.description: Closed enum that drives the generated factory's signature variant. standard: the one universal error-factory shape (messages?, inputErrors?, errorCode?, category?, traceId?) — ALL optional; the errorCode / category overrides are how a delegating domain factory stamps a specific code + category on its base status. none: no factory generated for this code. Every keycustodian entry is standard (the delegating emitter implements standard + none; a 400 standard entry delegates to D2Result.ValidationFailed, a 500 standard entry delegates to D2Result.UnhandledException).

doc.description: XML <summary> text rendered on the emitted constant + factory.
